records.title: refactor(lsp): route repair-packet decisions through the producer authority
records.release_claim: LSP repair actions, command-time rendering, and packet fields consume the same producer-owned eligibility decision
records.reason: Without this bridge the editor can re-grow manual readiness/actionability conjunctions that disagree with the central authority. The architecture guard closes the duplicate-authority seam.
records.non_claim: This does not alter gate predicates, execute commands, or promote preview evidence; the only behavior delta is fail-closed withholding where cross-language oracle visibility is unresolved.
